newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded in afternoon standoff.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded in afternoon standoff.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market was untraded on Monday afternoon, although there was an Exchange for Physical of 145 lots done in June.
"There have been very thin volumes, it's not particularly impressive at all," said a futures broker. "It's just been a bit of a Mexican stand-off all day," he added.

Only 20 lots were done in three separate trades in the morning session, with July unchanged, September slightly down and March 1998 fractionally up. Most of the twelve monthly contracts settled below the settlement prices on Friday, but with such little activity the movement was dismissed as irrelevant.
The 20 lots traded compare with 215 lots traded last Monday, traditionally a quiet day, and 25 lots on Monday 7 April.
